title: GovernanceResultReceptor
description: Identifies the receptor that receives governance results. The ontology reference defines which governance domain consumes evaluation outcomes. Source: ITIP Meta-Governance Ontology; GSM Receptor semantics.

ontologyRef.description: URI reference identifying the governance ontology this receptor consumes results for (e.g., 'gsmarc://gsm-ontology/gdpr/v1'). Defines WHERE governance outcomes are delivered. Identity-bound: receptors of the same Definition always consume results for the same ontology. Source: ITIP ontology catalogue.
